method: Fresh original PE-byte disassembly and concrete model/agent VMT reads. Previously recovered common lifecycle method bytes rehashed against the same original executable. No emulation, GUI execution or production conversion imports.

scope.lifecycle: Fresh target model created by TCBusUnitConversion.Convert; no caller edits or earlier target programming hydration.
scope.registration_dependency: toolkit-input-unit-conversion-source-proof.json establishes the original pair, class and agent selections. Native schema and persistence evidence are separate.

constructor_and_learning.concrete_wrappers: All seven selected model constructors directly call TCBusKeyInputUnit.InternalCreate and add no learning-state changes.
constructor_and_learning.enabled_predicate: Delphi Unicode lexical comparison target FirmwareVersion >= literal 1.2.63; true at exact 1.2.67.

conversion_order.operation: Factory GetUnit creates a fresh target instance; factory calls its CreateInWorkSpace constructor at 0xc1a877.
Store source model pointer at target offset 0x158. This does not copy source model learning attributes.
Load source ProgrammingParameters, Database. Learning-state hydration here belongs to the source instance.
Store selected tweaker at target offset 0x15c.
Save target UnitCreate, Database; AgentSave creates database identity and scalar attributes, not programming parameters.
Load target UnitAttributes, Database; dispatch uses LoadDatabaseUnitAttributes at 0xcb8c44.
Save target AlignUnit; AlignUnit first calls AlignUnitNoSave at 0xcc02fd.
AlignUnitNoSave calls tweaker after same-name agent string alignment.
AlignUnitNoSave dispatches BeforeUnitConversionSave, including the learning hook.
Only after the hook returns, AlignUnit sets up target programming information.
Target PP load occurs after the learning hook; it is not an earlier source of target model history.
PP SET sequence uses final writable flags.
Later AlignUnit flow reloads target ProgrammingParameters after its save; this cannot retroactively affect the hook.

deferred_reads.effect: Clears the change marker at offset 0x1d only; no lazy programming load or change to Boolean value offset 0x70.

input_tweaker.effect_on_selected_constructor: Only InfraRedBank is present among these 13 names. Missing-name lookup is a no-op.

bcnc_normal_save_boundary.learn_defaults_effect: Sets model LearnMode and LearnAnyApplication false during ordinary programming save.
bcnc_normal_save_boundary.reason: AgentSave calls SaveProgrammingInformation only for the ProgrammingParameters verb. Original Convert supplies AlignUnit. AlignUnit directly calls ParameterProgrammingLoad, ParameterProgrammingSetAll and ParameterProgrammingSave; none dispatches the ordinary before-save virtual. CoreKey AgentSave also bypasses its subsequent light-level save for AlignUnit.

preservation: GroupAddress remains the aligned original source string; no array reshape or hex rewrite.
IndicatorFunction remains the aligned original source string; no 1/3 remap or trailing-space rewrite.
Fresh target LearnedFlag PP value is retained; source PP history does not replace target model history.
At KEYBC and BCNC targets, brightness is immutable. At KEY1/2/4 targets it is re-enabled.
Ordinary BCNC microfunction and learn-default rewrites are absent from this conversion path.
limitations: Static source proof only; original GUI and physical acceptance are unclaimed.
Only the declared 1.2.67 fresh-target profile is addressed; earlier target firmware can change the learning predicate.
Ordinary editing/saving of BCNC units is a different workflow and may invoke its model-dependent defaults.
Native schema aliases, accepted PP shapes and persistence require separate acceptance evidence.
The sensor self-conversion is not admitted by these seven model facts.
